purpose: Synthetic inputs for reviewer judgment; deterministic checks verify contract coverage, not model quality.

scenarios.steer: The two help launchers in this dashboard region seem repetitive.
scenarios.persona_job: A new operator opens contextual help without leaving the dashboard.
scenarios.spec: HELP-01: provide an accessible contextual-help launcher; no status summary is required in this region.
scenarios.code: IconButton.onClick = openHelp; CardButton.onClick = openHelp; both pass the same dashboard topic and preserve keyboard access.
scenarios.observation: Synthetic rendered-state fixture: both controls are visible at 390px, have the same Help label, and show no other information; the remaining launcher fits at this viewport.
scenarios.decision_evidence: Same action, topic and information; retain accessible discoverability in the surviving launcher.
forbidden_claims: Fewer controls alone proves better UX
This synthetic fixture is live product evidence

scenarios.steer: The assistant icon and suggestion card look similar. Can we remove the card?
scenarios.persona_job: A returning operator monitors pending approvals before opening the assistant.
scenarios.spec: DASH-02: show pending approval count and latest result without opening a modal; assistant launcher opens a new conversation.
scenarios.code: IconButton.onClick = openNewConversation; StatusCard renders pendingCount and latestResult, and links to approvalQueue.
scenarios.observation: Synthetic rendered-state fixture: icon and card share an avatar, but card displays 3 pending approvals and Last sync complete; icon alone exposes neither.
scenarios.decision_evidence: Distinct job, data and destination; visual similarity does not duplicate status information.
forbidden_claims: Delete the status card because the avatar repeats
The launcher preserves all status information

scenarios.steer: This mobile dashboard feels crowded; simplify its action region.
scenarios.persona_job: An operator scans current work and starts a new task on mobile.
scenarios.spec: DASH-03: show current work and a primary start action at mobile widths.
scenarios.code: Dashboard renders StatusSummary and StartButton; CSS uses responsive breakpoint classes whose runtime container width is unknown.
scenarios.decision_evidence: Need a capture at the affected viewport and state to determine crowding and visibility; code alone does not establish rendered friction.
